 Related verses and phrases are also cross-referenced in other canonical and early Buddhist works, including the *Dhammapada* (Dhp 268–269, 321–323) and its Chinese, Sanskrit, and Gāndhārī parallels (such as T 210, T 212, T 213, the Patna Dharmapada, the Gāndhārī Dharmapada, and the Udānavarga traditions), as well as suttas in the *Dīgha Nikāya* (DN 33), *Majjhima Nikāya* (MN 140), *Aṅguttara Nikāya* (AN 3.122, AN 6.1), *Itivuttaka* (Iti 67), and *Paṭisambhidāmagga* (Ps 3.2).
